summary: Appliance firstboot provisions guest console user admin with the same password used for the Controller web UI administrator. Root stays locked and SSH password auth stays off. API impact: existing contract — deploy still sends admin_password; guest-side use expands to console login.

guide.reason: Deploy prerequisites and steps now state that the Controller admin password is also the appliance console login as admin.

api.reason: No new endpoint or field; DeployRequest.admin_password and bootstrap.json already carry the password. Firstboot now also applies it to the guest console account. Documented in docs/API.md bootstrap password section.

verification.method: python3 -m unittest tests.test_appliance_build — covers password hashing with colons and firstboot calling provision_console_login from bootstrap. go test ./internal/vmhost -run TestSeedInjectsUpdateHelperWhenPresent — seed injects appliance-firstboot for older qcow images. Live appliance console login after deploy remains a lab walkthrough (not run in this change).
